title: Lane funding
description: Which funding role pays for each Claude lane, the role's target secrets, and the secrets each lane's job reads today. Contract: docs/conventions/pr-pipeline/README.md, Funding.

org.description: The GitHub organization whose secrets the roles name.

secretPrefix.description: The role id in upper snake case.

tokenSecret.description: secretPrefix + _CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: the subscription token the role's lanes are to read.

keySecret.description: secretPrefix + _CLAUDE_API_KEY: the API key the role's lanes are to read when keyed.

keyed.description: Whether the role holds an API key. True only when one of its lanes runs on run-claude-cli.

id.description: The job id in the workflow.

launcher.description: What runs Claude for the job: ci-workflows' run-claude-cli action, anthropics/claude-code-action, or the claude CLI called from a run step. Only run-claude-cli takes an API key.

triggers.description: The event names under the workflow's on:, the events that start the lane.

gate.description: How the job stops a run nobody trusted: author, a check-trusted-trigger result it needs or the intake reusable's allowed-author-ids; same-repo, its if: requiring the workflow_run head repository to be this one. Required when a trigger is pull_request_target, issues, issue_comment or workflow_run.

currentSecrets.description: The Claude secrets the job reads today, until its wiring moves to the role's tokenSecret and keySecret.
